Opus needs 2 kB/s. OUT OF STOCK (the 512 MB #4899 $9.50 and 4 GB #6039 $12.50 are also OOS). Breadboard test of the SD-NAND path.

name: CS SD NAND 1 Gbit (128 MB), LGA-8 6x8 mm
notes: SD-in-SPI-mode: nRF has no SDIO host; Zephyr sdhc-spi + FATFS; SD spec caps SPI at 25 MHz, nRF9151 SPIM 8 MHz (~0.5-0.8 MB/s), nRF5340 SPIM4 up to 32 MHz (~1-2 MB/s read, 0.3-1 MB/s write). Opus needs 2 kB/s. XTX datasheet: active 30 mA max, standby 0.2 mA max (clock stopped). That exceeds the whole ~0.15 mA pendant idle budget, so it MUST be power-gated (TPS22916) with a ~250 ms re-init. 2.7-3.6 V only, so it needs a 3.0 V+ rail. 3,647 stock. Holds 128 MB (~18 h of 16 kbps Opus).
